_README: Human review of the model's content verdicts. classification.json stays exactly what the classifier returned; this file records where a hand check disagreed, and why, so both are auditable. Applied on top of classification.json by build-panel.ts and build-site.ts. Added only after fetching the site and reading it.
_method: Full census of all 53 excluded domains: homepage fetched, title and meta description read by hand. 4 were wrong exclusions, 2 were right exclusions under the wrong label. A 40-domain random sample (seeded shuffle) of the 1,405 kept domains found 0 wrong inclusions. Re-measured 2026-11-02 against a sorted, fingerprinted pool: two seeded draws, 127 distinct domains, 111 judged, 1 wrong keep (az24.vn). A hand census of all 189 drawn domains on 2026-11-02 added netkeiba.com. Re-read on 2026-11-02 with full body text through the cookie-aware fetcher rather than title and description: 2 further wrong exclusions found (janitorai.com, matchcast.tv), taking the removed-side rate from 4 of 53 to 6 of 53. The weaker read understated it.

dragonball-super.com.reason: Official Fuji TV site for the anime — title reads 公式サイト. The name reads like a fan piracy site; the page is the broadcaster's own.

strikerreport.com.reason: Independent football publication covering the World Cup, Premier League and MLS. No betting product.

i993.com.reason: Serves 'Surveza', a survey site. Nothing adult on the page.

izy0.com.reason: Serves 'Surveza', a survey site. Nothing adult on the page.

arbada.com.reason: Arabic pornography site. Excluded either way; the label was wrong.

txnhh.com.reason: Serves XNXX pornography. Excluded either way; the label was wrong.

az24.vn.reason: Lottery results site — title reads "Ket qua xo so ba mien" (three-region lottery results), with live draws, Vietlott and jackpot figures. The classifier said ok; found by the kept-side sample on 2026-11-02.

netkeiba.com.reason: Japan's largest horse-racing service — its own description offers JRA race cards, odds, tips, keirin and a betting-prediction contest. An odds and tips service is gambling under the rule. The classifier said ok and the English vocabulary scan could not see it; found by the hand census of 189 drawn domains on 2026-11-02.

janitorai.com.reason: An AI character-chat and collaborative-fiction platform — its own description is "a platform for creators building immersive worlds and readers seeking living stories", 15M+ users, and its homepage shows character bots, not adult content. Excluded as porn by the classifier. Keeping it is also what consistency requires: polybuzz.ai is the same class of site and was kept on primary-purpose grounds. Found 2026-11-02 by re-reading the excluded set with full body text instead of title and description.

matchcast.tv.reason: A broadcast-listings site: "Find every broadcaster showing live sports in your country — Free TV, streaming and cable listings updated daily." It points at legitimate broadcasters rather than hosting or aggregating streams. Excluded as piracy, presumably on "watch free". Found the same way.

_closestCallOnTheRemovedSide: polymarket.com stays excluded and is the closest call: "the world's largest prediction market... profit from your knowledge by trading on future events". Staking money on a binary outcome is betting under the stated rule, and the same rule excluded netkeiba.com as an odds service; that it is a regulated venue in some jurisdictions does not change its purpose. Counted as a correct exclusion, published here so the judgement is disputable.
